strategy: One PR per iteration; each PR targets the preceding branch. No automatic merge.

rows.title: [1/30] Preserve explicit literals from one-shot iterables
rows.summary: Generator literal protections were consumed before comparison and file evidence.
rows.validation: Targeted rewrite tests cover list/generator parity, bound files and invalid literal arguments.

rows.title: [2/30] Reject discarded grants and conflicting review options
rows.summary: Empty malformed grants and manual-review combinations were silently ignored.
rows.validation: Rewrite and evidence regressions exercise explicit invalid grants, normal defaults and manual option conflicts.

rows.title: [3/30] Use physical Markdown line boundaries
rows.summary: Unicode separators split physical lines and could fabricate a closing code fence.
rows.validation: Markdown regression cases cover every splitlines-only separator, LF/CRLF and real fenced content.

rows.title: [4/30] Expose literal and quotation protection in check
rows.summary: Users could not request term or quotation preservation through the bounded check command.
rows.validation: Command and checker integration tests execute planned argument lists and reject incompatible comments options.

rows.title: [5/30] Require exact evaluation request and output packet sets
rows.summary: Unexpected empty output packets were invisible to collection and missing requests were accepted.
rows.validation: Evaluation integrity and collection regressions cover extra, missing, empty and duplicate packets.

rows.title: [6/30] Add five-domain relationship preservation evaluations
rows.summary: Mechanical token checks cannot verify ownership, time windows, negation or commercial commitments.
rows.validation: Fresh skill/baseline generation and recorded per-case semantic assessment; no professional certification or model-brand inference.

rows.title: [7/30] Preserve Markdown task completion markers
rows.summary: Changing unchecked tasks to completed tasks passed prose checking.
rows.validation: Markdown checks cover both directions, ordered lists, editable labels and protected-code controls.

rows.title: [8/30] Preserve image versus hyperlink roles in Markdown
rows.summary: An image could become a text link with the same destination and still pass.
rows.validation: Inline, full, collapsed and shortcut references plus escaped markers and nested/code labels.

rows.title: [9/30] Protect positional and formatted printf placeholders
rows.summary: Changing %1$s to %1$d or altering width and precision escaped the placeholder check.
rows.validation: Formatting-field regressions include mapping, positional width, precision, escaped percent and ordinary percentage prose.

rows.title: [10/30] Validate and normalize explicit language tags
rows.summary: Malformed language selectors produced usable-looking plans before failing at language resolution.
rows.validation: Canonical tags, regional variants, unsupported syntax and valid missing-language controls.

rows.title: [11/30] Preserve ordered endpoints in numeric ranges
rows.summary: Reversing 5%–10% to 10%–5% passed a multiset-only numeric comparison.
rows.validation: Range regressions cover endpoint order, separators, signs, moved sentences and protected-span boundaries.

rows.title: [12/30] Apply selected saved style cards through explicit commands
rows.summary: Style cards could be saved, but explicit editing commands had no bounded selector for reusing them.
rows.validation: Command boundary checks and an independent file-based style application exercise preservation and read-only card handling.

rows.title: [13/30] Select verification evidence files explicitly
rows.summary: Verify accepted generic input files but could not distinguish claims from selected evidence sources.
rows.validation: Parser boundary tests and independent source-grounded verification retain citations and unresolved claims.

rows.title: [14/30] Expose read-only literal wording scans as scan
rows.summary: The local wording scanner had no discoverable bounded chat command.
rows.validation: Command integration runs actual scans, checks language and file limits, and validates relocated packaging.

rows.title: [15/30] Keep verification findings concise without losing evidence limits
rows.summary: Forward-test responses repeated source limits and appended generic audit/process disclaimers after complete findings.
rows.validation: Repeat the same raw verification requests with revised delivery guidance and assess preserved claims, citations and conditions.

rows.title: [16/30] Add read-only runtime diagnostics with doctor
rows.summary: Version output alone could not identify missing helpers, broken guides or invalid bundled resources.
rows.validation: Healthy, damaged, missing-dependency and relocated runtime checks; no user input reads or repairs.

rows.title: [17/30] Support protected email and URI autolinks
rows.summary: An unchanged contact address in angle brackets made the entire prose check unsupported.
rows.validation: Email/mailto and scheme autolinks, changed destinations, malformed forms and editable surrounding prose.

rows.title: [18/30] Preserve explicitly delimited LaTeX formulas
rows.summary: Changing symbols inside backslash-delimited formulas passed when numerals stayed the same.
rows.validation: Inline/display math, multiline content, surrounding prose, escaped delimiters, code boundaries and unmatched spans.

rows.title: [19/30] Keep check inputs bound to explicit files
rows.summary: A dash in a file selector invoked stdin and could compare an empty stream instead of the named original.
rows.validation: Reject both stdin positions and retain literal dash filenames via explicit paths; specialized stdin helper remains usable.

rows.title: [20/30] Reject nonfinite evaluation timeouts before execution
rows.summary: NaN and Infinity bypassed positive timeout checks and could reach subprocesses or evidence metadata.
rows.validation: Entry-point regressions reject nonfinite and nonpositive limits before writing evidence or calling a process; finite timeouts retain existing behavior.

rows.title: [21/30] Diagnose unusable Python helpers without executing them
rows.summary: Existing but syntactically broken check helpers were reported as a ready runtime.
rows.validation: Damaged helpers must degrade diagnostics with filenames; compilation must not execute helper code or create bytecode.

rows.title: [22/30] Select named scan rules and report the executed scope
rows.summary: The local scan always ran every rule, so users could not limit it to endings or openings without unrelated candidates.
rows.validation: Execute selected-rule plans, reject unknown or wrong-language selectors, preserve default coverage and source bytes.

rows.title: [23/30] Preserve common single-brace interpolation fields
rows.summary: Renaming user.name or changing a conversion inside single-brace placeholders passed prose checks.
rows.validation: Regression cases cover field names, indexes, conversions, formats, clear prose, protected code and long malformed inputs.

rows.title: [24/30] Reject ambiguous and unknown evaluation event records
rows.summary: Duplicate event fields could hide tool activity, unknown event types were ignored and nonfinite JSON usage was accepted.
rows.validation: Protocol regressions cover ambiguous/nonfinite JSON, unknown and malformed events, Unicode separators inside strings and valid local CLI stubs.

rows.title: [25/30] Bind scan locations to the exact input content
rows.summary: Scan findings exposed offsets without a content identity and could remain apparently valid after a concurrent file edit.
rows.validation: File and stdin scans record exact byte hashes; a changed or removed input suppresses stale findings; ordinary scans stay read-only.

rows.title: [26/30] Preserve operand order in numeric ratios and fractions
rows.summary: Reversing 1:3 to 3:1 or 1/4 to 4/1 passed the numeric multiset comparison.
rows.validation: Ratio/fraction regressions preserve complete literal expressions, valid prose movement and boundaries around code, lines and ordinary separators.

rows.title: [27/30] Match evaluation language fallback to runtime precedence
rows.summary: Evaluation guessed Hans for bare zh and favored bundled exact locales over frozen user fallback packs, unlike the runtime resolver.
rows.validation: Compare candidate sequences against runtime selectors and exercise frozen external precedence, region scripts and bare-language behavior without model calls.

rows.title: [28/30] Load selected frozen domain guides for domain evaluations
rows.summary: Domain-tagged CLI cases omitted their selected domain guide while tools were forbidden, so the generator could not follow the requested domain workflow.
rows.validation: Prepare all fifteen real relationship cases without model calls, verify only their selected profile is hashed and supplied, and reject missing or unsafe domain resources.

rows.title: [29/30] Document scoped workflows and installation diagnostics
rows.summary: User-facing setup and usage still omitted scan, doctor, saved-style reuse and evidence selectors, and described every CLI invocation as planning only.
rows.validation: Execute documented diagnostic, plan and local scan/check examples against disposable fixtures; validate Markdown resource links.
